lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Boss!

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: I know this is a bit sudden,

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: but can you tell me

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: what you think of Liter?
Where's this coming from?

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: I know that Liter can come off as cold,

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: but once you get to know her, she's actually a really warm person.

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: I'm worried people might misunderstand her.
I really like Liter.
You should respect your elders.

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Do you really mean that?

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: It feels like it's lacking conviction.

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Is that the only reason you treat her with respect?

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: If that's true, I feel kinda bad for her...
Then, what do you think of her?

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Me?
You're the one who's closest to her, so your opinion matters most.

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: I obviously

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: hold Liter in high regard!

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: She treats me incredibly well!
For example?

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: She always sends me messages

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: in codes that are tough to crack!

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: That's her way

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: of teaching me to always use my head

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: and hone my creative skills!
Um... They could also just be typos.

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Plus,

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: she can nag about trivial things for 14 hours straight,

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: ignore me when she's in the wrong,

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: gives Volt better meals than me,

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: and pretend to be sick

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: just to send me to Syuen whenever she calls.
Sounds to me like you're complaining an awful lot about her.

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: In any case, I respect Liter a whole bunch!
